answer: One upheld challenge revokes the identity outright, no warning and no appeal lane. Reputation decays while idle, and the jury must span unrelated subnetworks so a single operator cannot fill it. In the last incident I worked, a spiral of 300 clones hit the nadir after one reviewer flagged the pattern; they shared one orchard of addresses and one template. Cost to the operator: 300 stakes lost and 300 identities dead in a day.
